changes: Explicit package-scoped encoder; no GUI, global state or upstream runtime imports
Fail on missing mapping, CP932 alias normalization, literal proxy collisions or capacity overflow; no space fallback or truncation
Reserve source display characters across files and emit deterministic used-only UIF reverse mapping
Report full-preset-font collisions separately from used-only hook configuration
Project extension: optional private-use proxies (U+E757 downwards) that skip manifest/CLI reserved_codepoints and private characters already present in the workspace
Keep real Chinese translation JSON and original manifest unchanged; codec-aware validation plus engine semantic reparse
Publish mapping, UIF template and deployment instructions atomically with rebuilt resources
